correctness.rationale: The layer containing divisor n forces I(n)=sigma(n)/n>=3. For fixed total prime multiplicity the exchange inequality makes the largest abundancy use smallest primes, with largest exponents on smallest bases. All Omega<=4 exponent partitions have maximal I<3; of seven Omega=5 partitions only (3,1,1), (2,2,1), and (2,1,1,1) survive, respectively only 120,180 and 420/660/780 by the explicit bounds in RESULT.md. All five complete divisor partitions were independently checked for exhaustive disjoint divisor coverage and common sums 120,182,448,672,784. The finite partition check certifies examples, while the exchange and exponent-partition inequalities prove universal exclusion.
